title: Squishy and NO support
text:
Squishy and NO support. There is NO support to this so called "memory foam" pillow. It can be compared to a polyester pillow. The cooling is only so-so.

The Sleep Better memory foam cooling pillow is 1,000% better.

description: Choose your side to choose your comfort. The Sleep Innovations Reversible Cooling Gel Memory Foam Pillow gives you the cradling comfort of memory foam on one side and enhanced cooling on the other. The cooling gel helps remove excess heat from the body, keeping you at an optimal temperature. The two foams strike an impressive balance of comfort and support. Memory foam gently aligns your head and neck to encourage more deep sleep. Plus, it relieves pressure points that cause tossing and turning, so your sleep remains undisturbed. So whether you choose the same side every night, or switch from cool comfort to cozy comfort, we've got you covered.
